turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why did I find out about this from a gradebook on my son's phone?
Look, I'll own it if I messed up.
Then own it. Who entered the zero, and when did anyone speak to Owen?
Walk me through exactly what I did wrong with Owen's case. Step by step.
You want me to write your confession for you? Nobody called me before the zero went in, and Owen saw it on his phone in class. Check your own procedure, Hale, then tell me what you did.
